critical_code_review_comments: models_response.py — the majority of domain models (PropertyOut, BookingOut, ContractOut, NotificationOut, SavedSearchOut, SubleaseOut) declare only `id: str` and rely entirely on extra='allow'. This is intentional for the sweep (zero behaviour change) but provides no real typing benefit beyond proof-of-life. Future iteration should gradually promote the most stable fields into the model definition so the generated TS types in api.d.ts become load-bearing rather than opaque.

Several pre-existing test suites (test_admin_dashboard.py, test_ical_integration.py, test_upload.py, test_property_fields.py, test_optional_fields.py) require BASE_URL env var at import time and error out if unset. Not a regression from iteration 18 — they ERROR identically on main. Worth consolidating on the conftest.TEST_API_BASE pattern used by test_bulk_manager.py/test_refactor_regression.py.
Review request mentioned booking fields 'check_in/check_out' but actual schema uses 'start_date/end_date'. Wording only — shape is unchanged from prior iterations.

review request claim '93/98 endpoints typed' is exactly correct (verified via /openapi.json on localhost:8001). 5 untyped = FileResponse/StreamingResponse endpoints (admin/events SSE, contract-template, contracts/download, ical-export, bulk/template).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 (response_model contract-typing sweep) is GREEN end-to-end.
